meta.title: Google Vertex
meta.description: Service-account access to Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek on Vertex AI.

serviceAccountFile.label: Service Account File
serviceAccountFile.description: Path to the Google Cloud service account JSON file. Supports tilde (~) expansion. Defaults to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable.

project.label: Google Cloud Project
project.description: Google Cloud project ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, then GCLOUD_PROJECT, then the service account's project_id.

location.label: Vertex AI Location
location.description: Google Cloud region for Vertex AI endpoints (e.g., us-central1, europe-west1). Use 'global' for aiplatform.googleapis.com. Defaults to GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION or 'global'.

models.label: Claude Models
models.description: List of Claude model IDs to advertise. Leave empty to enable live discovery of available models from Vertex AI.

geminiModels.label: Gemini Models
geminiModels.description: List of Gemini model IDs to advertise. Leave empty to enable live discovery of available models from Vertex AI.

deepseekModels.label: DeepSeek Models
deepseekModels.description: List of DeepSeek model IDs to advertise from Vertex Model Garden. Leave empty to enable live discovery.

contextWindow.label: Claude Context Window
contextWindow.description: Context window size reported for Claude models (in tokens). Default: 200000.

maxTokens.label: Claude Max Output Tokens
maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for Claude models when not specified by caller. Default: 32000.

streamIdleTimeoutMs.label: Stream Idle Timeout
streamIdleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait between stream chunks before timing out. Default: 300000 (5 minutes).
